description: Trigger evals for atom-audit: it fires when the atom components need a table check against the component guidelines and the atom count is small, while atom-audit-fleet, design-spec-review, foundation-audit, design-bootstrap and a11y-audit handle a large parallel audit, a single component against its spec, token drift, a new design system, and a WCAG pass.

should_trigger: it's been about three weeks since we last checked the atoms. Can you go through them all and tell me which ones still break our component rules?
We added a new normative rule to COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md yesterday about reduced motion. I need a table showing which of our atoms fail it, plus the other rules, one row per atom.
Five new atoms shipped this sprint (Chip, Badge, Toggle, Avatar, Tag). Give me a row for each in ATOM_AUDIT.md so I can see who is missing memo or a 44pt touch target.
audit the atoms against the guidelines and give me the changes_needed count per row
I want to know how many atoms still use inline style objects or a useState press animation. Refresh the audit table and tell me the top fix groups, I'll turn them into slices myself.

should_not_trigger.prompt: We have 14 atoms in packages/design-system and I want every one checked against the component guidelines in one go, split across parallel workers to save time.
I just finished the Button atom. Can you compare it with its COMPONENT_SPEC.md for variants, states and token usage?
Our color and spacing tokens in code may have drifted from the foundations docs and the Figma variables. Find what was added or changed without documentation.
We have a Figma file for the new app and no design system folder yet. Set up the token docs and the component inventory from it.
Check the checkout flow screens against WCAG 2.2 AA and give me a per-criterion ledger with what needs manual review.
